title: MARGIN: A Risk-Aware Agent for Robot Program Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.32093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot-programming agents improve executable control policies through repeated testing and repair, yet binary success saturates while execution risk persists across unseen scenes. We introduce MARGIN, a risk-aware agent that converts successful robot rollouts into actionable evidence for program refinement. Its near-miss margin measures the fraction of the execution budget remaining in the slowest successful development rollout. The agent uses this signal to prioritize fragile programs, guide targeted repairs, and select revisions that preserve development success while increasing execution headroom. An exact safe-racing rule accelerates success-based candidate evaluation. We evaluate MARGIN across LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-90, and Robosuite. In our 80-task LIBERO-Pro reproduction, 78 programs attain perfect development success while accounting for substantial failures on unseen seeds. The near-miss margin predicts held-out failures with an AU

translated_title: MARGIN：一种用于机器人程序改进的风险感知智能体
translated_abstract: 机器人编程智能体通过反复测试与修复来改进可执行的控制策略，然而二元的成功指标会趋于饱和，而执行风险在未见过的场景中依然存在。我们提出了MARGIN，一种风险感知智能体，它将成功的机器人执行轨迹转化为可用于程序改进的可操作证据。其“险胜边际”衡量的是最慢的一次成功开发执行中所剩余的执行预算比例。该智能体利用这一信号来优先处理脆弱的程序、指导有针对性的修复，并选择那些在保持开发成功的同时能够增加执行余量的修订方案。一个精确的安全竞赛规则加速了基于成功的候选评估。我们在LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-90和Robosuite上对MARGIN进行了评估。在我们对80个任务的LIBERO-Pro复现中，78个程序达到了完美的开发成功率，但在未见随机种子上仍存在大量失败。险胜边际能够以AU……预测留出集上的失败（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出MARGIN，一种风险感知的机器人程序改进智能体，通过“险胜边际”指标（最慢成功执行中剩余的执行预算比例）识别脆弱程序、指导针对性修复，在保持开发成功率的同时提升程序在未见场景中的执行鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: MARGIN is a risk-aware agent for robot program refinement that introduces a "near-miss margin"—the execution budget remaining in the slowest successful rollout—to prioritize fragile programs, guide targeted repairs, and increase execution headroom on unseen scenes while preserving development success.
